rule_description: One or more weather or air quality measures is null
Average speed exceeds posted limit by more than the tolerance factor or is zero or negative
Any vehicle count field is negative
Vehicle_Count does not equal the sum of the five class counts
Zero flow recorded during the 06:00 to 20:00 active window
Flow exceeds four times the site and hour median
More than one record exists for the same site date and time
Observation date falls outside the declared reporting period
A sensor site reports more than one road type or speed limit
Incident type is Collision but Accident_Flag is not 1
